g.text: Figure 3 — UML Component diagram — application components and interfaces
The four packages are the Spring Modulith application modules. Spring Security remains an
adapter/runtime boundary: Authentication, SecurityContext and session types stop before
OperatorContextPort. Detector implementations also stop behind the project-owned
RiskSignalDetectorPort and emit only derived RiskSignalEvidence. CustomerReviewQueryPort
bounds the operator surface independently of the complete CustomerActivityPort snapshot used
by analysis. AnalysisContextBuilder is an application-layer projection: Stage 1 and Stage 2
retain complete CustomerSnapshot semantics, then exact full-history totals are separated from
bounded model-facing details immediately before AnalysisModelPort. GoF Adapter labels identify
boundary translation roles; Strategy seams identify interchangeable implementations; the
analysis application service acts as a Facade over orchestration.
